name: Deploy Website to Pages

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main # Change to 'master' if your default branch is named master

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # This creates a temporary deployment staging folder on the server
      - name: Merge Folders for Deployment
        run: |
          mkdir staging_dir
          cp -r src/* staging_dir/
          mkdir -id staging_dir/public
          cp -r public/* staging_dir/public/ 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5

      # This tells GitHub to upload the merged directory
      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: './staging_dir'

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
